text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Мэдзиро Райан
have come
to an end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the Twinkle Series continues. As for
our next
goal...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Trainer, how was my time on that lap?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Really?! It's great to see my new plank
exercises
showing some results!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm doing good! At this rate,
my next
goal should be...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ryan has won two Grand Prix races in
the same
year. I wonder what her next
dream will be.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, wanna know what it is? It might
be a little
surprising.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: It's that big of a dream?

text_block_list.text:
I don't know whether it's big or not... It's

unexpected more than anything.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I've conquered the Takarazuka Kinen
and the
Arima Kinen Grand Prix. My
next goal is...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
To beat the record time for a
2,200-meter turf
race!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Beating the record time... That really is
heading in
a different direction.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking a lot about what's at
the heart
of everything I do.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
And I realized that it's speed. I train to
gain good
times. That's how I win and
make a name for
myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I get treated like a star because I can run
fast!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Without speed, I'd be nothing. So I don't
want to
forget what's most important for
me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to break the record!
I'll train
every day and strengthen my
core, even if it's just
to get a tenth of a
second faster!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: ...I never wanna stop getting faster.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ryan has changed. But at the same time,
she's
very much the same.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She'll never stop working out, regardless
of her
mental state. That alone might be
her greatest
strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, watch me during this
homestretch! I'm
gonna blast straight
through to the finish!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
And next time I'll do even better! I'll do
it faster
and better than anyone else!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан will never stop running
toward
becoming the world's fastest
athlete.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And I'll continue to support her as she
pursues her
new dreams.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, and romance! I gotta get to that
ASAP.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That's right... We can't forget her other
important
dream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
